confirmed_scope: Core identifier-scoped or document owner-scoped retrieval preserves eligible lexical order, without semantic supplementation. No language, query labels, expected paths or score thresholds choose the route.
ordinary: Take the first range of every distinct semantic top20 path in semantic rank order, then the first range of lexical-only paths in lexical order. Fill remaining slots with extra semantic then lexical ranges in their channel order, removing identical rows and retaining cap2/path and top20. No candidate refill beyond either channel's existing twenty rows.
preservation: For ordinary navigation every semantic top20 path remains represented and its first appearance cannot move later. This preserves document navigation, not all ranges, answer quality or proof coverage. A full twenty-distinct-path semantic set leaves no slots for new lexical paths; report that tradeoff, never expand the budget.
unavailable: Missing model stays lexical-only in original order. Corrupt assets/bindings and stale require-current admission fail, never become semantic-only fallback.
acceptance: Keep the existing per-case semantic language top20/first5 and lexical exact first5 regression gate. Existing language thresholds remain unchanged. Compare fresh same-matrix baselines on both previously observed cohorts; no new holdout or cross-corpus ranking-fix claim.
scope: Test-only parent document navigation selection, same pinned model and resource caps. No Core scoring, authority, currentness or Pack completion change, production enablement, Stable backport or model sweep.
